SELECT p.*, true AS has_pending_action
FROM pending_actions p
WHERE p.correlation_id = '{{ $json.correlation_id }}'
  AND p.status = 'pending'

    rollback_reason = 'AI verdict: false positive'
WHERE id = {{ $('Reconciliation Logic').item.json.pending_action.id }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO alerts (timestamp, src_ip, description, rule_level, correlation_id)
VALUES (NOW(), '{{ $json.body.alert.data.srcip || 'unknown' }}',
'{{ ($json.body.alert.rule.description || 'Wazuh alert').replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
{{ $json.body.alert.rule.level || 0 }}, '{{ $json.body.correlation_id }}')
ON CONFLICT (correlation_id) DO NOTHING

UPDATE alerts SET
 ai_classification = '{{ ($json.ai_analysis.classification || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
 ai_attack_type = '{{ ($json.ai_analysis.attack_type || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
 ai_confidence = {{ $json.ai_analysis.confidence_score || 0 }},
 mitre_tactic = '{{ ($json.ai_analysis.mitre_tactic || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
 analysis_context = '{{ ($json.ai_analysis.analysis_context || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
 reasoning = '{{ ($json.ai_analysis.reasoning || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
WHERE correlation_id = '{{ $json.correlation_id }}'

UPDATE alerts SET action_executed = COALESCE(action_executed || ' | ', '') || 'AI_BLOCK:{{ $('Routeur Agent IA').item.json.actions_to_execute.find(a => a.type === 'block_ip')?.target || 'unknown' }} | HIVE_CASE:{{ $('Create the hive case').item.json._id || 'none' }}'
WHERE correlation_id = '{{ $('Routeur Agent IA').item.json.correlation_id || $('Reconciliation Logic').item.json.correlation_id }}'

UPDATE alerts SET action_executed = COALESCE(action_executed || ' | ', '') || 'AI_BLOCK_PORT:{{ $('Routeur Agent IA').item.json.actions_to_execute.find(a => a.type === 'block_port')?.target || 'unknown' }}:{{ $('Routeur Agent IA').item.json.actions_to_execute.find(a => a.type === 'block_port')?.port || '' }} | HIVE_CASE:{{ $('Create the hive case').item.json._id || 'none' }}'
WHERE correlation_id = '{{ $('Routeur Agent IA').item.json.correlation_id || $('Reconciliation Logic').item.json.correlation_id }}'
